preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line.
The first line is an integer n between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
There are exactly n request lines following the first line.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 and name.islower() and name.isalpha() for name in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each request is a non-empty string of 1 to 32 lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each request.

postconditions.expression: all((response == 'OK' or (response.endswith(str(int(response.split('1')[1])) if response.count('1') > 0 else '')) and response[:-len(str(int(response.split('1')[1])) if response.count('1') > 0 else '')) in requests) for response, requests in zip(stdout_lines, stdin_lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'OK' or a generated name formed by appending a positive integer to the requested name.

postconditions.expression: all((response == 'OK' and (requests not in seen_before) or (response != 'OK' and (requests in seen_before) and (response == requests + str(min(i for i in range(1, 1000000) if requests + str(i) not in seen_before))))) for response, requests, seen_before in zip(stdout_lines, stdin_lines[1:], [set() for _ in range(n)]))
postconditions.description: For each request, if the name has not been seen before, output 'OK'; otherwise, output the name with the smallest positive integer suffix that has not been used yet, and update the set of used names.
